column1: # Accepted differences between MATLAB's message text and malt's, for one finding (path, line, ID).
# Read by tests/matlab_live.rs (live_messages_agree_with_malt): the message of both sides, after
# normalise_message (tabs and line breaks as spaces, trimmed), must be the same. Columns, tab-separated:
# path (relative to tests/fixtures), line, check ID, reason. An entry that matches no difference fails
# the test, so remove an entry once its difference is gone. Keep this list empty if you can.
